sources.formal_pool_crosswalk: DAV-1197 confirmed_contaminated_v1.csv / pending_review_v1.csv / clean_not_in_scope_v1.csv (51 formal H1b/B2/B3 pool)

limitations: DAV-1196 loose upper bound 259 is NOT reproducible with current scripts; closest reproducible criterion (same-ref raw40 AND qfq40 in refs_final) yields 208.
pending_review_v1 (18) is a conservative superset defined as 'formal pool reports containing any raw40 disclosure reference minus confirmed'; it is a fail-close guard, NOT proof of contamination.
pending_review_v1 must never be relabeled confirmed without per-report evidence; any adjudication change requires evidence_ref + adjudication reason (no batch guessing).
No historical ReportDB rows are rewritten; isolation is enforced only at versioned-manifest clean-cohort filtering.
